subject: Co-ordinated Sciences (Double Award)
notes: Syllabus for exams in 2025–2027. Double award covering Biology, Chemistry and Physics. Core entries can achieve at most grade 5-5; Extended (Core + Supplement) is needed for grades 4-4 to 9-9. Uses g = 9.8 N/kg. Removed from this syllabus (don't teach as examinable): evolution, tropisms, sense-organ detail, smoking, teeth, pregnancy/placenta, anaerobic respiration in yeast, nitrogen/fertilisers, sulfur, carbonates.
